entry.title: New: Bill 153 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 4, ARTICLE 4, SECTION 4-4-26, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO ANIMALS

Increases the penalties for a noisy dog violation from $25 to $50 for the first violation, $75 to $100 for the second violation, $100 to $200 for the third violation, and $200 to $400 for any subsequent violation.

Latest action: Council: Bill 153 passes second & final reading - 06/19/24
